def test_any_int():
    # Valid cases where one value equals the sum of the other two
    assert any_int(5, 2, 7) == True, "5 + 2 == 7 should return True"
    assert any_int(3, 2, 2) == False, "No pair sums to the third value"
    assert any_int(10, 5, 5) == True, "5 + 5 == 10 should return True"
    assert any_int(2, 2, 4) == True, "2 + 2 == 4 should return True"

    # Order permutations should not matter
    assert any_int(7, 5, 2) == True, "2 + 5 == 7 in different order"
    assert any_int(2, 7, 5) == True, "2 + 5 == 7 in different order"

    # Negative integers
    assert any_int(-2, -3, -5) == True, "-2 + -3 == -5 should return True"
    assert any_int(-1, 1, 0) == True, "-1 + 1 == 0 should return True"
    assert any_int(-2, 3, 1) == False, "No pair sums to the third value"

    # Zero cases
    assert any_int(0, 0, 0) == True, "0 + 0 == 0 should return True"
    assert any_int(0, 1, 1) == True, "0 + 1 == 1 should return True"
    assert any_int(0, 1, 2) == False, "No pair sums to the third value"

    # Non-integer types should return False
    assert any_int(1.5, 2, 3) == False, "Float input should return False"
    assert any_int(1, 2.5, 3) == False, "Float input should return False"
    assert any_int(1, 2, 3.5) == False, "Float input should return False"
    assert any_int("1", 2, 3) == False, "String input should return False"
    assert any_int(1, "2", 3) == False, "String input should return False"
    assert any_int(1, 2, "3") == False, "String input should return False"
    assert any_int(None, 2, 3) == False, "None input should return False"
    assert any_int(True, 2, 3) == False, "Boolean input should return False"

    # Large integers
    assert any_int(1000000, 2000000, 3000000) == True, "Large int sum should return True"
    assert any_int(1000000, 2000000, 4000000) == False, "Large int non-sum should return False"

    print("All test_any_int tests passed!")


# Run the tests
if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_any_int()
